title: Formula validation passes timestamp(record.<date field>), which fails on every run against the field's date-only text
body:
repo:cloud#5 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjPP1zuWBNq3nBXVei9

Seam: spec:formula validateExpression date-text verdicts → runtime:service-automation evaluateValueEnvelope

Filing gate: ① reproduced. Found while fixing objectstack-ai/cloud#4717. The fix is objectstack-ai/cloud#4723, a cloud-side verify_build probe; this card is the shared gate's half.

## Defect

On the pin `b914e724` (18.5.0), `@objectstack/formula` `validateExpression('value', "isoDate(timestamp(record.borrow_date) + duration('168h'))", { fieldTypes: { borrow_date: 'date' } })` returns `errors: []`. `lint` `validateStackExpressions` gives the same verdict. At run time the flow engine's CEL refuses the expression on the field's date-only text (`"2026-11-16"`): `timestamp() requires a string in ISO 8601 format`. So every run of the flow fails and the field stays null.

The existing date-text verdicts miss this shape. `date-text-call` covers timestamp-only calls and `date-text-arithmetic` covers arithmetic, but `timestamp(<date field>)` (the string overload) is neither.

Reach: any hand-authored or AI-authored stack. It passes `os validate` and the publish door, then fails on every trigger. Measured live on staging in cloud#4717: the run on record `CexnsMC2iK0oiwRH` failed.

The supported shape exists and is documented: `isoDate(addDays(record.<date_field>, N))` (`formula/src/stdlib.ts` Dates block; `skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md`, the addDays row and "Shift a date").

## Done when

- `validateExpression` / `validateStackExpressions` report `timestamp(<date-typed field>)` (and the same field inside `+ duration(...)` arithmetic) as an error, with the fix hint `isoDate(addDays(record.<field>, N))`.
- A pin test covers the cloud#4717 expression (error) and the taught shape (clean, evaluating to the date + N over a date-only value).
- Once the framework refuses the shape, cloud's verify_build probe can retire to the shared verdict; that follow-up is the cloud seat's.

Dedupe words: timestamp date field date-text-call, validateExpression timestamp ISO 8601 date-only, date-text verdict timestamp string overload.
